'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Vinay Bhasker DS Cloud City: Port Town District''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Vinay Bhasker]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Dark Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
